actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The feral hunter makes two Hunting Knife or Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Hunting Knife
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 10 (2d6+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Mark Quarry
bonus_actions.desc: The feral hunter marks one creature it can see within 30 feet of it as its quarry until the start of the feral hunter's next turn. When the feral hunter hits the marked creature with a weapon attack, the weapon deals an extra 1d6 damage of the weapon's type to the target.

reactions.name: Reposition
reactions.desc: When the feral hunter takes damage, it can move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

special_abilities.name: Fey Resilience
special_abilities.desc: The feral hunter is resistant to the charmed and unconscious conditions.

special_abilities.name: Heightened Senses
special_abilities.desc: The feral hunter's Perception is 19 when perceiving by sight, hearing, or smell.

special_abilities.name: Precise
special_abilities.desc: A weapon that deals piercing damage deals one extra die of its damage when the feral hunter hits with it (included in the attack).

special_abilities.name: Woodland Walk
special_abilities.desc: Difficult terrain composed of nonmagical plants doesn't cost the feral hunter extra movement. In addition, the feral hunter can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental makes two Fiery Touch or Spit Fire attacks.

actions.name: Fiery Touch
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 12 (2d8+3) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Spit Fire
actions.desc: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 16 (3d8+3) fire damage.

bonus_actions.name: Fiery Dash
bonus_actions.desc:
Recarga: 4.
The elemental moves up to 20 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature without provoking opportunity attacks. Each space along that line catches fire until the start of the elemental's next turn. A creature that enters a burning space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 14 DEX save or take 5 (1d10) fire damage.

special_abilities.name: Elemental Nature
special_abilities.desc: The fire elemental doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Elemental Resilience
special_abilities.desc: The fire elemental is resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, it is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, and unconscious conditions.

special_abilities.name: Fire Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: The fire elemental's Stealth is 18 while in a Medium or larger fire.

special_abilities.name: Fire Form
special_abilities.desc: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. In addition, the elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature must succeed on a DC 14 DEX save or take 5 (1d10) fire damage and catch fire; until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the burning creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

special_abilities.name: Illumination
special_abilities.desc: The elemental sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

special_abilities.name: Water Susceptibility
special_abilities.desc: For every 5 feet the elemental moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fire giant makes two Flaming Greatsword or Lava Boulder attacks.

actions.name: Flaming Greatsword
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 28 (6d6+7) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Lava Boulder
actions.desc: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +7 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 19 (3d10+3) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Volcanic Burst
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The fire giant expels built-up heat from within itself, sending a blast of lava outward. Each creature within 15 feet of the fire giant must make a DC 16 DEX save. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (8d8) fire damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone. A creature that fails this save has disadvantage on the next save it makes against the giant's Pyroclastic Surge before the start of the giant's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Pyroclastic Surge
bonus_actions.desc: A burst of volcanic gas and rock fragments flows in a 60-foot-line that is 5 feet wide from the fire giant's outstretched hand. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 16 DEX save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn and pushed up to 15 feet away from the giant. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more is petrified in volcanic ash for 1 hour or until a creature spends 1 minute soaking the petrified creature in cool water.

special_abilities.name: Giant Attributes
special_abilities.desc: The fire giant is resistant to the stunned condition, and it is vulnerable to the prone condition.

bfrd_flesh-golem.name: Flesh Golem
bfrd_flesh-golem.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 17 (3d8+4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Creator's Anguish
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The golem releases a wave of emotional anguish from its core. Each creature within 15 feet of the golem must make a DC 15 WIS save. On a failure, a creature takes 31 (9d6) psychic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn, as its mind fills with memories of its greatest failures. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated.

special_abilities.name: Aversion of Fire
special_abilities.desc: If the golem takes fire damage, it loses its immunity to the frightened condition and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Berserk (55 HP or Fewer)
special_abilities.desc: When the golem starts its turn, roll a d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its HP. The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The golem must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a DC 15 CHA (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk. If the golem takes damage while still at 55 HP or fewer, the golem might go berserk again.

special_abilities.name: Construct Nature
special_abilities.desc: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Flesh Golem Resilience
special_abilities.desc: The golem is immune to poison damage and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, it is immune to exhaustion and to the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions.

special_abilities.name: Immutable Form
special_abilities.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

special_abilities.name: Lightning Absorption
special_abilities.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains HP equal to the lightning damage dealt.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The golem has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 9 (2d4+4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Acid Spit
actions.desc: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 11 (2d6+4) acid damage.

actions.name: Breath of Flinders
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The flinderbeast exhales splinters in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 DEX save, taking 18 (4d8) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus_actions.name: Short Step
bonus_actions.desc: The flinderbeast teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 15 feet of it.

reactions.name: Catch Snack
reactions.desc: When the flinderbeast is the target of a ranged weapon attack that uses ammunition made mostly of wood, such as an arrow, the flinderbeast can attempt to catch and eat the ammunition. The flinderbeast must make a DC 14 DEX save. On a success, it gains 3 (1d6) temporary HP and prevents the attack's damage.

special_abilities.name: Fey Resilience
special_abilities.desc: The flinderbeast is resistant to the charmed and unconscious conditions.

special_abilities.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
special_abilities.desc: The flinderbeast's Perception 18 when perceiving by hearing or smell.

actions.name: Slash
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 5 (1d8+1) slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Whirling Blade
bonus_actions.desc: The flying sword makes a Slash attack against a target it can sense within 5 feet of it.

special_abilities.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
special_abilities.desc: The sword is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by _dispel magic_, the sword must succeed on a CON save against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

special_abilities.name: Construct Nature
special_abilities.desc: The sword doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Construct Resilience
special_abilities.desc: The sword is immune to poison and psychic damage, and it is immune to exhaustion and the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the sword remains motionless and isn't flying, it is indistinguishable from a normal sword.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. _Hit:_ 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The frog can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Standing Leap
special_abilities.desc: The frog's long jump is up to 10 feet and its high jump is up to 5 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. _Hit:_ 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the frog can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: The frog makes one Bite attack against a Small or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the frog, and it takes 5 (2d4) acid damage at the start of each of the frog's turns. The frog can have only one target swallowed at a time. If the frog takes any damage from the swallowed creature, the frog must succeed on a DC 10 CON save at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 5 feet of the frog. If the frog dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

bonus_actions.name: Reeling Tongue
bonus_actions.desc: The frog lashes out its tongue at one Medium or smaller creature it can see within 15 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 STR save or be pulled up to 10 feet closer to the frog.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The frog can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Standing Leap
special_abilities.desc: The frog's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. _Hit:_ 8 (1d10+3) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the frog can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: The frog makes one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the frog, and it takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of the frog's turns. The frog can have only one target swallowed at a time. If the frog takes any damage from the swallowed creature, the frog must succeed on a DC 11 CON save at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 5 feet of the frog. If the frog dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

bonus_actions.name: Reeling Tongue
bonus_actions.desc: The frog lashes out its tongue at one Large or smaller creature it can see within 20 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be pulled up to 15 feet closer to the frog.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The frog can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Standing Leap
special_abilities.desc: The frog's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

special_abilities.name: Toxic Skin
special_abilities.desc: The frog's skin is coated in a hallucinogenic toxin. A creature that touches the frog or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must make a DC 13 CON save. On a failure, a creature is poisoned until the end of its next turn and experiences mild hallucinations while poisoned.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two Icy Greataxe or Ice Boulder attacks.

actions.name: Icy Greataxe
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 25 (3d12+6) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Ice Boulder
actions.desc: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 18 (3d10+2) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Avalanche
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The frost giant sends out a wave of snow in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 DEX save. On a failure, a creature takes 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and 18 (4d8) cold damage and is buried. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't buried. A buried creature is restrained and unable to breathe or stand up. A creature, including the buried creature, can take its action to free the buried creature by succeeding on a DC 16 STR check.

bonus_actions.name: Wintry Blast
bonus_actions.desc: A blast of wintry air extends in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide from the frost giant's outstretched hand. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or its speed is halved until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more is petrified in ice for 1 hour or until a creature spends 1 minute warming the petrified creature.

special_abilities.name: Giant Attributes
special_abilities.desc: The frost giant is resistant to the stunned condition, and it is vulnerable to the prone condition.

special_abilities.name: Ice Walk
special_abilities.desc: The frost giant can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. In addition, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

special_abilities.name: Snowsight
special_abilities.desc: The frost giant can see through areas obscured by snowfall, sleet, and other wintry precipitation without penalty.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gargoyle makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 10 (2d6+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 8 (2d4+3) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Fearsome Mien
reactions.desc: When a creature the gargoyle can see hits it with an attack, the gargoyle can shift its face to appear more monstrous. The attacker must succeed on a DC 13 WIS save or be frightened of the gargoyle until the end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Diving Pounce
special_abilities.desc: If the gargoyle is flying and moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claws attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the gargoyle can make one Bite attack against it as a bonus action.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. _Hit:_ 10 (3d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.desc:
The cube moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter a Large or smaller creature's space. When the cube enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 13 DEX save. On a success, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the cube. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed save. On a failed save, the cube enters the creature's space, the creature takes 10 (3d6) acid damage, and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns. When the cube moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 13 STR check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the cube.

reactions.name: Skewer Prey
reactions.desc: When the gelatinous cube is subjected to piercing damage, it can move a random creature engulfed by it to intercept the attack. The creature takes the piercing damage as if it were the target.

special_abilities.name: Ooze Cube
special_abilities.desc:
The cube takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but are subjected to the cube's Engulf and have disadvantage on the save. Creatures inside the cube can be seen but have total cover. A creature within 5 feet of the cube can take an action to pull a creature or object out of the cube. Doing so requires a successful DC 13 STR check, and the creature making the attempt takes 10 (3d6) acid damage.
The cube can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time.

special_abilities.name: Ooze Nature
special_abilities.desc: The cube doesn't require sleep.

special_abilities.name: Ooze Resilience
special_abilities.desc: The cube is resistant to the grappled and restrained conditions, and it is immune to exhaustion and to the blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, and prone conditions.

special_abilities.name: Transparent
special_abilities.desc: While motionless, the cube's Stealth is 15, even when the cube is in plain sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ghast makes one Bite attack and two Claws attacks. If one Bite attack and at least one Claws attack hit a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead, the target must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or contract ghoul hunger (see the Ghoul Hunger sidebar).

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 8 (2d4+3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead, it must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

special_abilities.name: Hungry Dead Nature
special_abilities.desc: The ghast doesn't require air or sleep. In addition, it must consume at least 2 pounds of raw meat every 24 hours, or it loses its immunity to exhaustion and risks starvation until it does so. While it has any levels of exhaustion from starvation, the ghast can't remove levels of exhaustion until it consumes at least 4 pounds of raw meat.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The ghast can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

special_abilities.name: Stench
special_abilities.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the ghast must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success, the creature is immune to the ghast's Stench for 24 hours.

special_abilities.name: Turning Defiance
special_abilities.desc: The ghast and any ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saves against effects that turn undead.

special_abilities.name: Undead Resilience
special_abilities.desc: The ghast is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

bfrd_ghost.name: Ghost
bfrd_ghost.languages: any languages it knew in life
bfrd_ghost.damage_resistances: acid,fire,lightning,thunder; bludgeoning,piercing,and slashing from nonmagical attacks

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ghost makes two Withering Touch or Telekinetic Throw attacks.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 18 (4d6+4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Telekinetic Throw
actions.desc: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 17 (6d4+2) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, depending on the type of object thrown. The ghost can throw only Small or smaller objects within range that aren't being worn or carried.

actions.name: Horrify
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The ghost speaks a haunting phrase, reveals the wounds from its death, or performs some other expression to scare creatures in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 WIS save. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't frightened. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more increases its age in years by 10 percent, rounded up. This aging can be reversed with a greater restoration spell or similar magic, but only within 24 hours of the aging occurring.

bonus_actions.name: Etherealness
bonus_actions.desc: The ghost enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Ethereal Plane, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

special_abilities.name: Ethereal Sight
special_abilities.desc: The ghost can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

special_abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
special_abilities.desc: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

special_abilities.name: Undead Nature
special_abilities.desc: The ghost doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Undead Resilience
special_abilities.desc: The ghost is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

special_abilities.name: Unfinished Business
special_abilities.desc: Unless its unfinished business is fulfilled, a destroyed ghost returns in 1d4 days, regaining all its HP and becoming active again within 10 feet of where it died. If presented with an object or piece of information related to its unfinished business, the ghost must succeed on a DC 13 WIS save or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn. After it has been incapacitated by a particular source, the ghost can't be incapacitated by that same source again for 24 hours. If presented with everything it needs to complete its unfinished business, the ghost permanently dies after completing it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ghoul makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack. If both attacks hit a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead, the target must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or contract ghoul hunger (see the Ghoul Hunger sidebar).

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 8 (2d4+3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead, it must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

special_abilities.name: Hungry Dead Nature
special_abilities.desc: The ghoul doesn't require air or sleep. In addition, it must consume at least 2 pounds of raw meat every 24 hours, or it loses its immunity to exhaustion and risks starvation until it does so. While it has any levels of exhaustion from starvation, the ghoul can't remove levels of exhaustion until it consumes at least 4 pounds of raw meat.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The ghoul can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

special_abilities.name: Undead Resilience
special_abilities.desc: The ghoul is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gibbering mouther makes two Bite attacks. If both attacks hit one Medium or smaller creature, the target must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. _Hit:_ 11 (2d8+2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rend Mind
actions.desc: One creature the mouther can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 WIS save or take 18 (4d8) psychic damage and suffer a random, short-term dread effect for 1 minute

bonus_actions.name: Blinding Spittle
bonus_actions.desc: The mouther spits an otherworldly goo at up to two creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 13 DEX save or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Aberrant Ground
special_abilities.desc: The ground within 10 feet of the mouther is dough-like difficult terrain. A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or its speed is halved until the start of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Aberrant Resilience
special_abilities.desc: The mouther is resistant to the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, and stunned conditions, and it has advantage on saves against spells or effects that would alter its form.

special_abilities.name: Gibbering
special_abilities.desc: The mouther babbles incoherently while it can see any creature and isn't incapacitated. A creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the mouther and that can hear the gibbering must succeed on a DC 13 WIS save or it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn and must roll a d8 to determine what it does during its turn. On a 1 to 4, the creature does nothing. On a 5 or 6, the creature takes no action or bonus action and moves its full speed in a randomly determined direction. On a 7 or 8, the creature makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.

bfrd_glabrezu.name: Glabrezu
bfrd_glabrezu.damage_resistances: bludgeoning,piercing,and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks,Demonic Resilience

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The glabrezu makes two Claw attacks and two Pincer attacks, or it makes four Crackling Flame Bolt attacks. It can replace both Claw attacks with two Crackling Flame Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 10 (2d4+5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage and 3 (1d6) lightning damage.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 16 (2d10+5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). The glabrezu has two pincers, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Crackling Flame Bolt
actions.desc: _Ranged Spell Attack:_ +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 6 (1d6+3) fire damage plus 10 (3d6) lightning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Manipulating Whispers

bonus_actions.name: Luring Song
bonus_actions.desc:
The harpy sings a magical melody. Every Humanoid and Giant within 300 feet of the harpy that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 11 WIS save or be charmed until the song ends. The harpy must use a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. It can stop singing at any time. The song ends if the harpy is incapacitated.
While charmed by the harpy, a target is incapacitated and ignores the songs of other harpies. If the charmed target is more than 5 feet away from the harpy, the target must move on its turn toward the harpy by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the harpy, the target can repeat the save. A charmed target can also repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. If the save is successful, the effect ends on it. A target that successfully saves is immune to this harpy's song for the next 24 hours.
